title: Bee Removal in New Brighton, Staten Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in New Brighton, Staten Island. Nest treatment, removal, and entry-point sealing. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: When wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, or carpenter bees build nests in your New Brighton property, professional treatment is essential for the safety of your family and neighbors. The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert stinging insect removal services throughout New Brighton — from the historic homes near Lafayette Avenue to the residential streets surrounding Clove Lakes Park. Our licensed technicians treat and remove wasp and hornet nests in wall voids, attics, eaves, and soffits, seal carpenter bee galleries, and eliminate ground-nesting yellow jackets and bumble bees, protecting your property from structural damage and repeat infestations.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Staten Island communities like New Brighton for over a decade, combining local expertise with humane bee removal practices. Our licensed technicians understand the unique challenges of New Brighton's mix of Victorian-era homes and modern residences, ensuring safe removal without harming the beneficial bee population.
localContext: New Brighton's tree-lined streets and proximity to the Staten Island Ferry terminal create active foraging territory for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets, especially during warmer months. The neighborhood's historic architecture — older homes with wooden eaves, soffits, and attics — provides ideal nesting sites for paper wasps, bald-faced hornets, and carpenter bees seeking shelter inside wall voids and roof spaces. Ground-nesting yellow jackets commonly establish colonies in lawns and landscaped areas throughout the residential blocks.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in New Brighton?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest in New Brighton?
faqs.answer: We typically respond to New Brighton stinging insect calls within 24 hours. Same-day service is available for dangerous situations involving aggressive yellow jackets, hornets near entryways, or nests inside occupied living spaces. Our team will assess the nest location and treat it as quickly as safe access allows.

faqs.question: What does bee and wasp removal cost in New Brighton?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Can carpenter bees and wasps damage my New Brighton home?
faqs.answer: Yes, carpenter bees bore tunnels into wood siding, eaves, fascia, and decks, weakening the structure over time. Wasp and hornet colonies that build paper nests inside wall voids can grow to thousands of individuals, and the nest material can stain ceilings and attract moisture. Yellow jacket nests near foundations create entry points for secondary pest activity. Prompt treatment and entry-point sealing prevent costly repairs to your New Brighton property.
